rows.en: Increases the health of the user by 4 and reclassifies it as a Legendary Pokémon (Alpha Strike · Beast Boost · capture on 6+ · 4 Journey Points). It is bound to the Pokémon and cannot be unequipped.
Increase the attack strength of Grass and Flying type moves by 1. Lets you encounter Shaymin at the Garden of Gratitude.
Increases the attack strength of Ice and Steel type moves by 1. Lets you encounter Regice at Westbreeze Ruins and Registeel at Firelilly Ruins.
Increase the attack strength of Fire and Ground type moves by 1. Lets you encounter Heatran at the Magma Chamber.
Increase the attack strength of Dark and Ghost type moves by 1. Lets you encounter Spiritomb at the Hallowed Tower.
Increases the attack strength of Rock and Ice type moves by 1. Lets you encounter Regirock at Valley Ruins and Regice at Westbreeze Ruins.
Increase the attack strength of Psychic and Water type moves by 1. Lets you encounter Manaphy at the Temple of the Sea.
Increase the attack strength of Ghost and Electric type moves by 1. Lets you encounter Rotom at the Grand Chateau.
Increases the attack strength of Steel and Rock type moves by 1. Lets you encounter Registeel at Firelilly Ruins and Regirock at Valley Ruins.
Prevents the effects of Celestial Aura when Dialga is encountered.
Prevents the effects of Celestial Aura when Giratina is encountered.
Prevents the effects of Celestial Aura when Palkia is encountered.
Only on the first attack against the user, deal 1 damage to the attacker and prevent them from switching out this turn.
Increase the attack strength of a move by 1, but the user may only use this move until switched out.
When the user is attacked, remove 2 regular hits. Only works on Weak/Moderate Pokémon or Pokémon that are not fully evolved.
The restored Heart of Sinnoh. This held item is required to battle Cyrus.
When the user attacks, replace 2 status symbols with 1 critical hit if possible.
Allows any fully evolved Starter Pokémon to use its Noble Form (State 2) when held.
Only on the first attack against the user, the user takes 2 less damage and is immune to any status effects inflicted this turn.
Increase the initiative of the user by 2 but decrease the attack strength of your moves by 1. Minimum 1 attack strength.
Roll 4 dice when rolling to capture.
Roll 6 dice when rolling to capture.
Roll 3 dice when rolling to capture.
Roll 5 dice when rolling to capture.
Replace any 1 status symbol with 1 regular hit once during your next wild encounter.
Discard only half of the Journey Points needed to evolve 1 Pokémon this turn, rounded down.
Fully restore your entire party.
Move 3 additional tiles this turn whilst preventing Alpha Pokémon from battling you.
You fail to capture a wild Pokémon 2 turns in a row during a battle.
You win a battle against another trainer or an Ultra Beast.
You have at least 1 of every Apricorn type in your bag.
You have captured a Legendary Pokémon.
You have 3 or more held items equipped in your party.
You have been victorious at a Swarm Battle.
You have 3 different Change of Fate cards in your hand.
A dice with faces 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5.
Requires Apex Strength: The user gains +6 health, +2 initiative and +1 attack strength to its moves.
Requires Catch of the Day: The user gains health equal to their Catch Size.

When the Cherish Ball is used to capture a wild Pokémon, it automatically captures that Pokémon. Additionally, if you release the captured Pokémon, you get the Cherish Ball back. Flip over when the Pokémon faints.
Follower token of Arceus.
A dice with faces -2, -1, 1, 2, 3 and 4 for tracking health bonuses.
A dice with faces -2, -1, 1, 2, 3 and 4 for tracking initiative bonuses.
Once at each Artifact Legendary Location, stamp it on your Landmark Tour sheet to search for the Legendary Pokémon there and make a clone of its card.
The user may be switched in from your party just before any damage is applied from an opposing attack.
All moves that match the Weather type gain +2 attack strength.
Base of the Weather Wheel: Sun (Fire), Snow (Ice), Rain (Water), Sandstorm (Rock).
